title: Te Whainga a te Kōti
intro: I roto i ngā ara o te mana, ka aroha tetahi tangata whai mana nui ki tētahi pononga he ataahua nō tetahi ao kē tōna. Nā tēnei aroha i ara ake ai he raupapa o ngā kaupapa i whakamātautau i te pono, i huraina ai ngā pono huna, ā, i te mutunga ka whakaū i te harakore o te pononga.
clues: I noho ahau i te whenua o te Naera, i roto i tētahi whare rangatira whai mana nui.
I haere mai tētahi taitama ki roto i tōku whare, ā, i ohorere tōku ao i tōna aroaro.
I ngana ahau ki te whakawai i a ia, engari i rapu piringa ia i roto i tōna Ariki.
I haehaea e ahau tōna kākahu i muri, engari i whakaaturia mai e ngā taunakitanga taku tinihanga.
Hei whakamutu i te kōrero pakiwaitara a ngā wāhine rangatira, ka karangahia rātou e au ki tētahi huihuinga, ā, ka whakatakotoria e au he mea koi ki ō rātou ringa.
I te mutunga, i whaki ahau i taku he ki te aroaro o te kingi, me te whakaae ki te pono.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I ngana ia ki te whakawai i a Hohepa, te Poropiti
I ngana ia ki te patu i te Poropiti a Mohi
I kī ia he atua wahine ia
I hanga e ia he pourewa hei wero i a Allah
Nāna i ārahi tētahi ope taua ki a Makkah
trial.answer: I ngana ia ki te whakawai i a Hohepa, te Poropiti

location.answer: He hāte i haehaea mai i te tuara

options: I whaki ia, i whakaae hoki ki te pono

outcome.answer: I whaki ia, i whakaae hoki ki te pono

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
